recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央是一顆巨大異常漿細胞，胞質豐富、深藍色並偏心，內有多個核（多核或多葉核）；周圍漿細胞也大小不一、核質比高。本圖多核特徵較核仁更明顯，核仁在此焦距下不易辨認。
features: Large atypical multinucleated plasma cell in the center with at least five to six nuclei or nuclear lobes
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear area
Nuclei with finely granular to open chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved at this focus
Surrounding immature plasma cells of variable size with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm
Thick smear area with out-of-focus red cells limiting fine nuclear detail
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased atypical plasma cells of variable size with eccentric nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. In the center is a large abnormal plasma cell with abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple nuclei or nuclear lobes with relatively open chromatin; distinct nucleoli are not clearly resolved in this thick, partially out-of-focus field, so the multinucleation is the more evident abnormality. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with atypical, multinucleated plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have many separate uniform nuclei with lighter granular cytoplasm, and megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus with granular pink cytoplasm, unlike this deeply basophilic cell with a perinuclear hof.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis with binucleate plasma cells
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small and mature with clock-face chromatin and only occasional binucleation, not large multinucleated forms with immature chromatin.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shows large immunoblastic cells with prominent single nucleoli and high proliferation, typically in immunodeficiency and often EBER-positive.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters of separate cells with distinct cell borders rather than a single cell with shared basophilic cytoplasm and plasmacytoid features.
